readiness_checks.requirement: Schema declares all required fields, forbids unexpected fields, and returns structured row-level failure paths.
Provenance entity, activity, and agent fields are separated and do not act as proof.
Symbol, role, definition artifact status, unit, dimension vector, conversion policy, uncertainty model, and B_Psi demotion are exact.
Metric signature, action sign, kinetic sign, frame, variation target, boundary terms, integration policy, and stress-energy convention are exact.
Baseline equation, primary switch, disabled terms, held terms, comparison method, residual tolerance, negative controls, and not_run status are exact.
Candidate parameter, observable target, bound, units, regime, mapping method, assumption basis, and uncertainty model are exact.
Proxy target, task/protocol route, modality, measurand, uncertainty, false-positive routes, discriminants, ethics boundary, and non-proof caveats are exact.
Expected output, non-support claim IDs, contradiction traps, and result object shape are written before any execution attempt.
